title: Myself
summary: MYSELF', pronoun A compound of my and self, used after I, to express emphasis, marking emphatically the distinction between the speaker and another person; as, I myself will do it; I have done it myse

inlines.v: MYSELF', pronoun A compound of my and self, used after I, to express emphasis, marking emphatically the distinction between the speaker and another person; as, I myself will do it; I have done it myself 1. In the objective case, the reciprocal of I. I will defend myself 2. It is sometimes used without I, particularly in poetry. MYSELF shall mount the rostrum in his favor.
